provenance.lineNumberAuthority: All line numbers refer to revision 8610102d (recorded head) via `git show 8610102d:<path>`. Concurrent uncommitted working-tree edits are intentionally NOT reflected.

summary: 47-A golden determinism rests on three independent layers. Live browser play is a superset of systems and env-gated features. The only existing profile concept locks gameplay backends.

layers.name: curated-systems-list
layers.behavior: run47a systems array omits massline/travel/world/AI families; only 13 gameplay systems (+ core).

layers.name: env-tier-feature-flags-off-under-node
layers.behavior: IS_BROWSER = typeof window !== 'undefined'. COMBAT_FLAGS / MASSLINE2_FLAGS / TRAVEL_FLAGS default most entries to IS_BROWSER (false under Node).

layers.name: explicit-scenario-combat-pin
layers.behavior: SCENARIO_COMBAT_FLAG_PINS['47a'] forces weaponImpulseConsequences:false even if a harness embeds browser defaults.

threeLayer47aDeterminism.implication: Any one layer can be incomplete alone; all three currently cooperate to freeze 47-A. Phase 2 must preserve golden hashes when migrating off env-selected gameplay.

existingProfileConcept.name: graphics/settings profile bootstrap
existingProfileConcept.whatItControls: UI/video/controls settings merge from localStorage before createRegistry
existingProfileConcept.lockedReason: Runtime backend selection is a build contract, not a player-profile choice (mergeProfileSettings restores base createGameState defaults).
existingProfileConcept.phase2Relevance: Backend selection is NOT environment-derived today — it is a locked settings field. Env-selected gameplay audit must target featureFlags + curated system lists, not profile bootstrap.

defaultGameplayBackends.notes: Live registry selectAISystem/selectFlightSystem switch on these settings keys.

TRAVEL_FLAGS.notes: stepPropulsion is on both legacy flight and flightV3 golden paths; ungated travel changes move frozen hashes.

highImpactFlagReaders.role: DIAGNOSTIC — installs window.__SF_FLIGHT_V3__ debug snapshot only

headlessSfSim47a.backends: set by harness (physics rapier-dynamic; flight legacy or v3 via CLI)

liveBrowser.backends: createGameState defaults locked against profile override

manifestGap.today: No single runtime manifest describes which systems + flags + backends a run uses.
closestExisting: pq017 ROUTE_SOURCES/REGRESSION_SOURCES (validation source digests, not sim systems)
manifestGap.phase2Target: One authoritative system/flag/backend selection path for production, golden, and lab profiles.
